name: LXD VM Boot Failure / Initramfs
checks: Inspect the VM console and identify the exact initramfs/filesystem error.
Identify the affected root filesystem/block device before running repair commands.
If filesystem inconsistency is confirmed, run the appropriate filesystem check/repair against the correct device.
Reboot and verify the guest agent and services return.
stop_condition: Stop before filesystem repair unless the affected device and filesystem problem are positively identified.
resolution: Repair the confirmed filesystem problem, then boot normally; do not run destructive repair against an unverified device.
